data.name: Dibya
data.gender_notes: Dibya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘divyah’ which means divine. The name Dibya signifies divine intelligence, knowledge, and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, it is a name of Goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and learning. The name Dibya carries the meaning “Divine Intelligence, Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dibya usually hope their child will grow to embody divine intelligence, knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dibya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Divine Intelligence, Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dibya total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
